svg.title: Group life of one or two times salary beside a larger household need
svg.desc: Labelled bars for one times and two times a ninety thousand dollar salary, next to a placeholder household need. Not a needs analysis.
svg.text: One or two times salary is the group benefit
Shape of the gap only. Use the needs worksheet for your number. 24 Sep 2026.

g.text: Placeholder. Your worksheet, not this bar.

svg.text: The group contract ends when the job ends. Personal term is the amount you still want the next morning.
Employer-paid group term premiums are generally a T4 code 40 taxable benefit. That is the premium, not the face amount.
Assuris: greater of $1,000,000 or 90% if a member insurer fails. It does not enlarge a 1x benefit.
Group continuation after a failure runs to the next renewal or six months, whichever is earlier.
